subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual team building event will be held on Friday, August 20th at the local park. Please RSVP by August 10th to confirm your attendance. The day will be filled with fun activities, team challenges, and a delicious BBQ lunch. We look forward to strengthening our teamwork and having a great time together. We hope to see you all there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
